description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'LookupTableApiResource' for managing lookup tables associated with surveys in the Apache Fineract Social Performance Measurement (SPM) module. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, and creating lookup table entries, with security and transaction management annotations.

classes.name: LookupTableApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing lookup tables related to surveys in the Fineract SPM module.

methods.name: fetchLookupTables
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all lookup table entries for a specific survey.

methods.name: findLookupTable
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific lookup table entry by key for a survey.

methods.name: createLookupTable
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new lookup table entry to a survey.

methods.name: findSurvey
methods.description: Private helper method to retrieve a survey by ID, throws exception if not found.
